about: The only hosts each cloud drive's requests may reach, over https. A leading '*.' is any name under that domain (OneDrive serves downloads and uploads from per-account hosts). The web build adds OneDrive's to connect-src when a OneDrive client ID is configured (packages/ui/vite/cloudConfig.ts); the desktop app sends to no other host (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/cloud.rs).
